title: Spatiotemporal Visualization
text: {mlr3spatiotempcv} makes use {plotly} create 3D plots visualizing spatiotemporal folds. Arranging multiple 3D plots {plotly} done via 3D subplots. Unfortunately, {plotly}’s subplot implementation dynamic. means multiple “scene” objects need specified plotly::layout() determine coordinates respective subplot. Depending number chosen folds user autoplot(), different number scenes different coordinates needs given align plots properly. Hence, manual action needed create properly aligned grid 3D plots. example create 2x2 grid showing four folds 3D subplots. makes use returned 3D plotly objects returned list autoplot():  Note: image shown static version created plotly::save_image(). Unfortunately, titles subplots created dynamically. However, manual workaround via annotations show RPubs post.
code: library(mlr3) library(mlr3spatiotempcv) task_st = tsk("cookfarm_mlr3") task_st$set_col_roles("SOURCEID", roles = "space") task_st$set_col_roles("Date", roles = "time") resampling = rsmp("sptcv_cstf", folds = 5)  pl = autoplot(resampling, task_st, c(1, 2, 3, 4),   crs = 4326, point_size = 3, axis_label_fontsize = 10,   plot3D = TRUE )  # Warnings can be ignored pl_subplot = plotly::subplot(pl)  plotly::layout(pl_subplot,   title = "Individual Folds",   scene = list(     domain = list(x = c(0, 0.5), y = c(0.5, 1)),     aspectmode = "cube",     camera = list(eye = list(z = 2.5))   ),   scene2 = list(     domain = list(x = c(0.5, 1), y = c(0.5, 1)),     aspectmode = "cube",     camera = list(eye = list(z = 2.5))   ),   scene3 = list(     domain = list(x = c(0, 0.5), y = c(0, 0.5)),     aspectmode = "cube",     camera = list(eye = list(z = 2.5))   ),   scene4 = list(     domain = list(x = c(0.5, 1), y = c(0, 0.5)),     aspectmode = "cube",     camera = list(eye = list(z = 2.5))   ) )
